During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] carried out an '''attack''' on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases on the astronomical object [[Ongary IX]].

==The battle==
The [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world of [[Ongary IX]] was captured by the CIS, hoping to claim its [[hfredium]] deposits. The celestial body's mine shafts were converted into heavily-fortified [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] bases for [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]].<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

While [[Army/Legends|ground forces]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were available, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] starfighter squadrons were committed to a military operation at [[Uvadala]], so the local [[Ividal Sector Forces]] were enlisted to lead the Republic's counterattack. The [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] of [[Foxfire Squadron]] were refitted as [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] to attack the Separatist positions in the mines with missiles armed with [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]]-made [[burrowing plasma charge]]s.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

The Republic forces encountered difficulties when it was found that the extreme brightness of the burrowing plasma charges' explosions would completely polarize the visors of [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmets]] and scramble [[Heads-up display/Legends|head-up displays]], resulting in two casualties within Foxfire Squadron in two bombing runs. For a third bombing run, the squadron's helmets were retrofitted with [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shields]], which were designed to be flipped down when the missile was launched to protect the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] from the explosion and be raised again once the flash had dissipated.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

Foxfire Squadron fought through a screen of Vulture droid starfighters before flying nap-of-the-earth to attack the mine. The attack was successful, collapsing the mine and destroying the Separatist base. However, one [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Jorn Kulish]], had the terrifying experience of his blast shield jamming as he tried to raise it, and narrowly avoided colliding with a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] before he was able to remove his helmet.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

==Aftermath==
The Republic was victorious and the Ividal Sector Forces were returned to [[Ividal]] aboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]]. However, the experience of the battle prompted Jorn Kulish to resign and seek passage to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] aboard the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']]. Kulish accidentally left his blast shield-equipped helmet behind on the freighter when he disembarked at [[Denon/Legends|Denon]], though he did not regret the loss.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />

[[0 BBY/Legends|Many years later]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] would use Kulish's helmet, still aboard the freighter now known as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], as part of his [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="TEGtW:AC" /><ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on Ongary IX was first conceived of at [[Celebration VI]] in [[2012]], where ''Star Wars'' author [[Jason Fry]] convened an impromptu discussion on why anyone might need an opaque [[Blast shield/Legends|blast shield]] attached to a flight helmet, as worn by Luke Skywalker in ''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope''.<ref name="ANH" /> Intended for ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', the piece was ultimately cut from the final book owing to word count constraints, but was later featured in ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a twelve-part blog series detailing material cut from the book.<ref name="TEGtW:AC" />
